{{Quote|She's this fully loaded droid, and what are your programmed skills?|[[Stuart Zissu]], comparing [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] skills to that of a science research droid|<ref name="Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four]]''</ref>}}
'''Science research droids''' were a line of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] that were produced during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As their name implied, these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were designed to collect specimens and conduct [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] research. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], their design was considered top-notch. In order to be adaptable to any terrain, they could retract their wheels and use feet instead.
